game_concept: A card battler set in Snowy Hold – Frozen Gatehouse, the frozen gate of the hold: the hold guard must handle frost imps while practicing functions. Core idea – Docstring Detective: Read docstrings to pick the right function for each case.
theme: Snowy Hold – Frozen Gatehouse: the frozen gate of the hold
core_gameplay_loop: In Frozen Gatehouse, repeat each round: Read docstrings to pick the right function for each case. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the cases value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Chain 6 consecutive correct decisions about cases to power up the hold guard and open the frozen well.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 3 (intro tier): Docstring Detective
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Docstring Detective' (Week 6 slot 9), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Frozen Gatehouse'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how cases changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost imps in Frozen Gatehouse.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 6.
